|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-41-Abyssin_Ornament_Wounded_Wookiee-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The release-sheet slip, the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show the original words (see [[Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee (V)]], [[Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee (V) (Errata 3)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Abyssin Ornament & •Wounded Wookiee (V)]]): Virtual Block 3 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 41)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 4, slip 41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: Creature attacks at pits are immune to At Peace and Yarna d’al’ Gargan until end of your next turn. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel an attempt to target a rancor with a character weapon. OR Use 1 Force (2 if a rancor on table) to ▼ Nal Hutta. STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, ▼ an Effect that is always [Immune to Alter] and choose: ▼ Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR ▼ Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-41-Abyssin_Ornament_Wounded_Wookiee.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 41 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 3 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1230_40">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock3Type (Virtual Block 3 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “USED: Creature attacks at pits are immune to At Peace and Yarna d’al’ Gargan until end of your next turn. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel an attempt to target a rancor with a character weapon. OR Use 1 Force (2 if a rancor on table) to ▼ Nal Hutta. STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, ▼ an Effect that is always [Immune to Alter] and choose to ▼: Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' One change: “choose: ▼ Rancor Pit …, OR ▼ Power Of The Hutt …” becomes “choose to ▼: Rancor Pit …, OR Power Of The Hutt …” (one arrow before the colon instead of one before each choice; the list writes it “choose to deploy from Reserve Deck:”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.

STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, ▼ an Effect that is always [Immune to Alter] and choose: ▼ Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR ▼ Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (41).
